chunks: My father narrated, may God be pleased with him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah al-Barqi, from his father Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from someone he mentioned, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

Eat melons, for in them are ten characteristics: It is the fat of the earth, there is no disease in it and no harm, it is food and it is drink, it is fruit, it is a herb, it is a side dish, it increases sexual potency, it washes the bladder, and it promotes urination.

key_terms.إِدَامٌ: A side dish or accompaniment to bread/stew
key_terms.إِشْنَانٌ: A type of herb or green vegetable used as a side dish
key_terms.شَحْمَةُ الْأَرْضِ: The fat/richness of the earth, indicating high nutritional value

ai.seo_question: What are the ten health benefits of eating melons according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the melon as a comprehensive provision (*rizq*) that embodies multiple categories of sustenance, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the holistic benefits of natural foods. The description of it as 'fat of the earth' and free from 'gha'ila' (disease or pestilence) underscores its role in maintaining physical purity and vitality, linking dietary practices to spiritual and bodily well-being in the Imami tradition.
